name: Southern Remedy

tenures.role: tag team — billed as one of the UWA's newest tag team additions
tenures.source: the fed's own Random Rumble card of 24 February 1997, republished whole in NFW's news archive (promotions/nfw/archive/news-1997-02-24-uwa-2-0-random-rumble.html)
tenures.note: First and last seen are the one surviving UWA document; the fed's own record does not state a debut or a departure.

caption: A Confederate-bandana tag team billed as one of the UWA's newest additions, whose debut match against Toby was pulled off Random Rumble night for time and turned into a backstage brawl instead.
